title: [26.21] Challenger Garen Top Guide
author: Federals1

Fiora.summary: With Conqueror, this is a lane to abuse early: fight her often in the first levels to build a lead before she scales.

Aatrox.summary: Take Conqueror and look to duel him early and repeatedly to get ahead, rather than waiting to scale.

Camille.summary: A Conqueror lane: force early fights to snowball a lead while your early dueling is strongest.

Ornn.summary: Too tanky for Garen to deal the burst needed to trigger Stormraider's Surge, so short hit-and-run trades don't work well unless you build much more damage.

KSante.summary: Like other tanks, he soaks enough damage that you can't reliably trigger Stormraider's Surge, which blunts your Stridebreaker trading pattern.

Darius.summary: He can buy early health and armor to stop you triggering Stormraider's Surge, unless your first item is something like Trinity Force. Manage your cooldowns carefully in this juggernaut lane.

Sett.summary: Can stack early health and armor to deny your Stormraider's Surge proc; consider Trinity Force first if you want the keystone to work.

general: Garen plays very differently by keystone. With Conqueror, fight a lot early for lane priority; at level 6 with Ignite and Doran's Blade the all-in can nearly one-shot some opponents, but you get kited easily (save Q to cleanse slows) and fall off badly late. With Stormraider's Surge, play slower, abuse passive sustain and farm toward Stridebreaker, the first big spike, after which you do repeated short hit-and-run trades until a full combo with ult kills. Mid game, Stormraider's lets you side lane and escape collapses, and from about level 13 he is very hard to kill; with Conqueror, split pushing usually gets you collapsed on and killed. Aim to end around 25-30 minutes, as some champions out-duel him very late. Rotate with Q speed and use E to proxy or steal camps.
